How to read these scores

Q follows the original authors’ DiDi evaluation configuration (VOT 0.7.1, burnin=0, ignore_unknown=False, weighted=False). Predicted masks are first converted to bounding boxes by the original script, while the original GT is retained; sequence scores are then averaged with equal weight. The original script replaces the first frame with Special(1), whose handling follows the installed toolkit exactly. A is accuracy on successful frames with positive overlap; R is the proportion of successfully tracked frames among frames annotated as target-present. Success requires IoU>0, not IoU≥0.5.

Annotation audit: 90 sequences contain groundtruth_old.txt backups, which the default VOT loader prioritizes. This page explicitly uses the official groundtruth.txt from the original archive. Backups were moved outside the loader directory and retained; 5955 officially unknown frames were excluded according to the protocol and are no longer scored against backup boxes. No GT values were changed, and no models were rerun.View audit evidence.

“Shared difficulty” is a diagnostic rule used here: both models have whole-sequence Q below 0.5. “Shared low overlap” requires both models to have IoU<0.2 on the same valid target-present frame. These rules select intervals for review; they are not official categories and do not establish identity switches or memory contamination. Videos show native masks; cyan denotes GT. When the original GT is a box, only a box is shown, and it must not be treated as pixel-level segmentation ground truth.

The two models differ in software versions, image-loading implementations, and assigned GPUs. This page therefore does not provide a controlled speed comparison or a mechanism ablation under identical environments. SAMURAI is compared using controlled first-frame mask initialization, rather than the first-frame box setting of its original demo.English analysis report (web) · Archived PDF · Official analysis JSON · Statistics and rules
